title: Deterministic Governance Gates, Authority Tiering, Pre-Flight Verification & Protected Mutation Admission
acceptance_criteria: GOVERNANCE_PREFLIGHT_V1 and GOVERNANCE_DECISION_V1 contracts implemented with typed reason codes
Explicit authority taxonomy implemented (HUMAN_ONLY, HUMAN_PREAUTHORIZED, DETERMINISTIC_POLICY, DELEGATED_WITH_GATE, AUTONOMOUS_WITHIN_LEASE, FORBIDDEN)
CAPABILITY != AUTHORITY strictly enforced (models/providers cannot acquire authority merely by being capable)
Target authority vs current active enforcement distinguished (unavailable capabilities fall back closed)
Human authorization receipt contract implemented with content hashing (model cannot claim approval in prose)
Preflight pipeline implemented (scope, STC lease, FinOps envelope, secrets, trust domain, readiness, reversibility)
Raw secret access and constitutional mutation permanently forbidden for agents
Confused deputy and cross-WP/cross-resource authority reuse strictly prevented
Short-lived decisions and TOCTOU stale authorization defense implemented
FinOps pre-authorized envelope gate enforced with zero self-budget escalation
Readiness gate integration distinguishes relevant from irrelevant unknown metrics
Governance evaluation telemetry emitted without policy feedback loop
Mandatory adversarial TDD fixtures (G01-G30) fully passing
Full repository test suite, doctor checks, linters, and independent review PASS
description: Deterministic governance preflight and admission gate subsystem providing typed preflight contracts, multi-tier authority resolution, human authorization receipt verification, FinOps envelopes, and confused-deputy protection.
